title: 邮箱域名 SSO 登录丢掉登录前的跳转地址：未登录打开记录链接、走 SSO 登录后落到应用而不是那条记录
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZeHNsF3RWcWpj7rGj

① product defect · Source: the TIER_DEFAULT contract review of PR #36738 (#36732), note N1, comment 7105904397. It predates that PR.

## What
A signed-out user opens a record link and is sent to the login page with `?redirect=<record>`. Password and social sign-in honour that redirect (`LoginPage`). The email-domain SSO path does not. `ui/packages/auth/src/LoginForm.tsx` `handleSso` builds `callbackURL` from the base plus a fixed suffix: `/home` before #36738, `/` after it. So the user lands in their last app instead of the record they opened.

## Expected
The SSO `callbackURL` carries the pre-login `redirect` when it is safe. Use the same safety check `LoginPage` applies: a same-origin path only, never an absolute or protocol-relative URL. After SSO, the user lands on the record. With no redirect, nothing changes.

## Acceptance
- A test pins that `callbackURL` carries a safe redirect and drops an unsafe one (absolute URL, `//host`).
- A browser check: signed out, open a record URL, sign in via SSO, land on the record. If no SSO provider is available locally, say so and pin it by test.

Grading: `area:ux` · Bug · Impeded · users of SSO-enabled orgs who follow a link while signed out ⇒ p2 (UX rule). Effort S. Evidence: read (review N1; `LoginForm.tsx`, `LoginPage.tsx`).

Dedupe: no open card names the SSO callback redirect.
